method: Paired Node/Vitest CPU-only baseline (5353de9 SpiderLegSolver) versus updated solver, alternating run order in one process; 48 rigs, 100 warm-up frames, 300 timed frames per run; solve and final matrix update; excludes GPU and instance upload. Temporary comparison fixtures removed after measurement.
caveat: Synthetic local CPU comparison, not physical-device FPS. Separate headless browser p95 timings increased under varying software-renderer load; do not infer an end-to-end CPU or FPS improvement from this microbenchmark. Regression tests separately enforce the reduced transform count and correct foot contacts.
